description: Dublin City Council (Dublin City Cultural Audit) publishes an annual count of sport pitches and sport facilities in the Dublin region, with title, description, address lines, NACE code, latitude and longitude, DCC area, census small area and electoral division; counted as part of the Dublin City Cultural Audit. Coverage: the Dublin region, Ireland; annual updates, record created in 2024 and last modified on 2025-06-19. Format and access: CSV, GEOJSON, downloadable without registration from the Smart Dublin open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: a venue audit, not an asset register: dimensions, surface and condition are not recorded; the feature count was not read. Simulation uses: service-accessibility and open-space capacity analyses, and use of sports grounds as flood storage or evacuation assembly points. Related catalogue records: Dublin City Council: heritage sites, historic monuments and government buildings (data-dublin-heritage-sites-monuments-and-government-buildings).
